[[Template:C]] converts two case-insensitive hex digits into a style for the appropriate DF colors. The colors are:
{| cellspacing=0 cellpadding=2 {{c|0|f}}
|- {{c|f|0}}
|0
|Black
|#000000
|- {{c|f|1}}
|1
|Blue
|#000080
|- {{c|f|2}}
|2
|Green
|#008000
|- {{c|f|3}}
|3
|Cyan
|#008080
|- {{c|f|4}}
|4
|Red
|#800000
|- {{c|f|5}}
|5
|Magenta
|#800080
|- {{c|f|6}}
|6
|Brown
|#808000
|- {{c||7}}
|7
|Light Grey
|#c0c0c0
|- {{c||8}}
|8
|Dark Grey
|#808080
|- {{c|f|9}}
|9
|Light Blue
|#0000ff
|- {{c||a}}
|A
|Light Green
|#00ff00
|- {{c||b}}
|B
|Light Cyan
|#00ffff
|- {{c|f|c}}
|C
|Light Red
|#ff0000
|- {{c||d}}
|D
|Light Magenta
|#ff00ff
|- {{c||e}}
|E
|Yellow
|#ffff00
|- {{c||f}}
|F
|White
|#ffffff
|}

For example, '''<nowiki>{{c|f|3}}</nowiki>''' produces '''style="color:#fff;background-color:#008080;"''', '''<nowiki>{{c|7}}</nowiki>''' produces '''style="color:#c0c0c0;"''', and '''<nowiki>{{c||D}}</nowiki>''' produces '''style="background-color:#f0f;"'''. Styles like this can be used in many places. In fact, this template was used to color the table rows above. '''<nowiki><span {{c|f|0}}>white text on a black background</span></nowiki>''' can be used to color small amounts of text, but the major use is in coloring tables, table rows, and table cells for ASCII diagrams.

Additional style can be added as a third parameter. E.g., '''<nowiki>{{c|8|0|font-family: Courier New, monospace}}</nowiki>'''.
